P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text and typographic elements.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present; the pull-quote block is editorial, not social proof.

P10.rationale: Three oversized percentage numerals (30%, 60%, 30–50%) function as large decorative typographic anchors in the lower half of the page, and a large opening quote glyph appears in the pull-quote block.

P11.rationale: The three large statistics are bound to real cited numbers but are presented as isolated typographic callouts rather than charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math visualisations.

P12.rationale: The upper half is reasonably dense with two-column body text, but the lower third feels under-filled with generous empty space below the pull-quote block, preventing a truly magazine-quality density.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream paper texture is applied to the background, providing a mild atmospheric quality rather than flat white, though it is very understated.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no imagery at all, so there is no stock photography to penalise, though the absence of any specific visuals keeps it generic in feel.

N08.rationale: A large empty region occupies the bottom quarter of the page below the pull-quote block, representing purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photograph; all text sits on the plain textured background or within the solid pull-quote panel, so readability is not compromised.
